title: Late-Reported Vehicle Replacement Charge — Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing Fee Disclosure
content:
Where a customer holds a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate that lists the scheduled vehicles, a vehicle amendment carries a vehicle-report lateness charge that depends on how long after a vehicle replacement took effect it was recorded on the customer's Cardinal Personal Auto Policy records.

## The charge

The reporting delay is counted in calendar days from the effective date of the vehicle replacement recorded within the past month to the date it was recorded (where more than one replacement was recorded in that month, the latest recorded is used).

| Reporting delay | Vehicle-report lateness charge |
|---|---|
| More than 30 days | 15.00 |
| More than 14 days but no more than 30 days | 7.50 |
| 14 days or fewer | None |
| No vehicle replacement recorded within the past month | None |

"Within the past month" covers replacements whose recorded date is less than one whole month before today, whole months being counted from the recorded date to today.

## Examples on both sides of each limit (hypothetical dates)

| Replacement effective | Recorded | Delay | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 May | 15 May | 14 days | None |
| 1 May | 16 May | 15 days | 7.50 |
| 1 May | 31 May | 30 days | 7.50 |
| 1 May | 1 June | 31 days | 15.00 |

Only vehicle replacements are measured; an addition or a removal recorded late carries no vehicle-report lateness charge.
